protocol.averaging: Equal arithmetic mean of two corrected scores; same method across seeds, no extra fitting
protocol.calibration: Full-template threshold/force calibration, old single-seed choices reused and replayed exactly
protocol.selection: Primary: simplest candidate within one paired-bootstrap SE gap of cal argmax; secondary: raw argmax and best mean-BCE
protocol.bootstrap: 4000 circular 7-day resamples,seed20261013,all45 cal calendar days including event-empty days
protocol.complexity: number of active neural members,alpha,conditional thresholds,force,prefer BCE,prior old seed
protocol.uncertainty_scope: In-sample sensitivity only: checkpoints and thresholds used full cal. No independent confidence bound.
protocol.assessment: Old inspected public TRAIN development dates; all policy choices sealed before assessment cache load

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

cal_sensitivity.scope: In-sample sensitivity after fitting thresholds/checkpoints; no independent confidence or promotion guarantee.
